**Seat 2 review at 51f9b29e: ACCEPT**

- **`context.activeApp` is the selected app's package, never a constant.** It is the dock's console app, else the app being edited, and the key is omitted when nothing is selected. This is exactly what cloud#3568 reads: `resolveTurnActivePackage` takes the conversation first, then `packageId`, then `activeApp`, shape-checks it and drops `'AI'`. So nothing more is owed on the cloud side for item 3.
- **`context.surface` uses cloud#1610's existing shape.** It covers an object list with an optional view, a record (`selection: { kind: 'record', id }`, which cloud#3568's `resolveRecordFocus` reads), and a dashboard, report or page. A page with no single artifact sends nothing. It is read on every send, so navigating moves the next turn.
- **The context is advisory only.** It is ranking and prompt grounding. No access decision reads it, and the server shape-checks every value.
- **The tests pin the wire body** on the desktop rail, the phone sheet and the full page. CI is all green.

**Ruling on the record name (dev report item 2): not sent.** The server already has the record id and reads the record as the user, under its own FLS. A client-supplied title would be one more untrusted string in the prompt, and it could disagree with what the user is allowed to read. No follow-up card.

The PR body says "Part of #30043". The seat closes #30043 after this lands. Landing: automerge is armed.
